title: Counter loop over an embedded alphabet
statement: Given a symbol type $\Gamma$, a state set $S$, a Boolean-symbol machine $M$ with $k$ work tapes and state set $S$, an embedding of Boolean symbols into $\Gamma$, a distinguished state $a\in S$, and an optional designated exit state, form a machine over $\Gamma$ with $k+1$ work tapes and the counter-loop states. It starts in the decrement phase in run mode; body states follow $M$ on the first $k$ tapes, while decrement states run the one-tape decrement routine with its Boolean symbols embedded into $\Gamma$ on the added tape, with both phases routing successor states according to the counter-loop rules; done and escape states stay fixed without moving or writing.
hypotheses_covered: A natural number $k$ of work tapes
A symbol type $\Gamma$ with decidable equality
A state set $S$ with decidable equality
An embedding of Boolean symbols into $\Gamma$
A machine over $\Gamma$ with $k$ work tapes and state set $S$
